title: Identification of plant transcriptional activation domains.
authors: Morffy, Nicholas; Van den Broeck, Lisa; Miller, Caelan; Emenecker, Ryan J; Bryant, John A Jr; Lee, Tyler M; Sageman-Furnas, Katelyn; Wilkinson, Edward G; Pathak, Sunita; Kotha, Sanjana R; Lam, Angelica; Mahatma, Saloni; Pande, Vikram; Waoo, Aman; Wright, R Clay; Holehouse, Alex S; Staller, Max V; Sozzani, Rosangela; Strader, Lucia C
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过酵母文库大规模鉴定拟南芥转录因子激活域(ADs)，并开发神经网络预测模型，揭示ADs序列特征组合，其对象为无序区域(ADs)且涉及共激活因子互作，但互作机制建模深度有限，方法上以AI预测为主。
abstract: Gene expression in Arabidopsis is regulated by more than 1,900 transcription factors (TFs), which have been identified genome-wide by the presence of well-conserved DNA-binding domains. Activator TFs contain activation domains (ADs) that recruit coactivator complexes; however, for nearly all Arabidopsis TFs, we lack knowledge about the presence, location and transcriptional strength of their ADs(1). To address this gap, here we use a yeast library approach to experimentally identify Arabidopsis ADs on a proteome-wide scale, and find that more than half of the Arabidopsis TFs contain an AD. We annotate 1,553 ADs, the vast majority of which are, to our knowledge, previously unknown. Using the dataset generated, we develop a neural network to accurately predict ADs and to identify sequence features that are necessary to recruit coactivator complexes. We uncover six distinct combinations of sequence features that result in activation activity, providing a framework to interrogate the subfunctionalization of ADs. Furthermore, we identify ADs in the ancient AUXIN RESPONSE FACTOR family of TFs, revealing that AD positioning is conserved in distinct clades. Our findings provide a deep resource for understanding transcriptional activation, a framework for examining function in intrinsically disordered regions and a predictive model of ADs.
abstract_zh: 拟南芥（Arabidopsis）中的基因表达受超过1,900个转录因子（transcription factors, TFs）调控，这些转录因子通过全基因组范围内高度保守的DNA结合域（DNA-binding domains）的存在而被鉴定。激活型转录因子含有激活域（activation domains, ADs），这些结构域能够招募共激活因子复合物；然而，对于几乎所有拟南芥转录因子，我们对其激活域的存在、位置及转录强度缺乏了解(1)。为解决这一空白，本研究采用酵母文库方法，在蛋白质组规模上实验性鉴定拟南芥激活域，并发现超过一半的拟南芥转录因子含有激活域。我们注释了1,553个激活域，其中绝大多数据我们所知是此前未知的。利用生成的数据集，我们开发了一种神经网络，能够准确预测激活域并识别招募共激活因子复合物所必需的序列特征。我们发现了六种不同的序列特征组合，这些组合能够产生激活活性，为探究激活域的亚功能化提供了框架。此外，我们在古老的生长素响应因子（AUXIN RESPONSE FACTOR）转录因子家族中鉴定了激活域，揭示激活域定位在不同分支中具有保守性。我们的发现为理解转录激活提供了深度资源，为检查固有无序区域功能提供了框架，并提供了激活域的预测模型。
